We introduce CROW: a Commonsense Reasoning Benchmark for Real-World Tasks, a multi-task benchmark containing high-quality datasets for six real-world NLP tasks: machine translation (MT), open-domain dialogue (DG), dialogue summarization (DS), intent detection (ID), stance classification (SC), and safety detection (SD).

quote: We evaluate models on CRoW using two scores: Macro-F1 of predicting valid and invalid targets, and Situational Accuracy, a stringent metric that reports whether the model correctly identifies the validity (or invalidity) of all targets for a given context.
